A third strong anionic (TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate @16) is post-fragrance and only recorded.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: C2 elements present - early (prominent) silicone Dimethiconol @10, cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @15, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @7, and a C2-list humectant Panthenol @24 as its own entry; cleansing strength does not lower conditioning (C2). Counter-signals: the guar is post-fragrance and Panthenol is a late trace, so moderate is the realistic neighbor.
